top_choice_rationale: P001 honours the physiology of GLP-1 and its active form (Drucker, Holst, Mojsov), a mature chain from proglucagon processing and GLP-1(7-36) to glucose-dependent insulin and appetite actions, confirmed independently and validated in large randomized trials for glycaemia, weight, cardiovascular and renal outcomes. A single three-person part keeps the credit clean and the citation scope on the discovery of what the hormone is and does, not the drug. Attribution is the weak point (Mojsov's contested priority, Habener-group work and Knudsen outside the trio), but this does not outweigh the strength of the achievement, so no award ranks below it.
